## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:cli` · `area:devpath` · `pm:queue`. Direction: a boot warning when a loaded app's branding names a runtime asset the server cannot serve

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post #6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-07T13:02Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

Triage: lands in `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts` (the runtime assets dir, `:3716`–`:3720`, whose comment says it "Silently skips if no assets directory exists") and `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts:615` (`if (!fs.existsSync(assetsDir)) return;`) ⇒ `domain:cli`; rationale: the CLI's `start`/`serve` path.

- **Why p2:** a broken logo and favicon on every signed-in page, with nothing said on either side. It was measured on 17.7.0 (hotcrm, an artifact boot outside the project directory).
- **Direction (ruled here):**
  - At boot, when a loaded app's `branding.logo` or `favicon` names `/runtime/assets/<file>` and that file is not servable, print one warning. It names the app, the file, the directory searched and `OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR`.
  - When the assets directory is absent, say so in that same line, not silently.
- **⛔ Not taken here:** carrying the branding files in the artifact. That changes the deployable unit's shape, and only the CLI path is measured. It becomes a card of its own if a measured deployment (cloud, Docker) shows the loss.
- **Pins:**
  - an artifact boot from a directory without `assets/` prints the warning once, naming the file;
  - the same boot with `OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR` set, or `assets/` present, prints nothing and serves the file (control).
- `Clause-②: no`: an operator log line only. Patch changeset.

- `packages/cli/src/utils/console.ts`: `createRuntimeAssetsPlugin` (from `:603`; the `if (!fs.existsSync(assetsDir)) return;` at `:615`).
- Pins beside them in `packages/cli`: an artifact boot from a directory without `assets/` prints the warning once, naming the app, the file, the directory searched and `OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR`. The control: the same boot with `OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR` set, or `assets/` present, prints nothing and serves the file.
- `.changeset/*.md`: `@objectstack/cli` `patch`.
- ⛔ Not taken: carrying branding files in the artifact (triage). ⛔ No `packages/spec` path. ⛔ No route added or removed, and no change to what `/runtime/assets/*` serves. ⛔ Not `packages/runtime/src/app-plugin.ts` `:1104`–`:1140` (declared by `domain:spec` seat 2 for #13458, `6038311314`). (Stop on breach and explain in the report.)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: default (opus)`. `dispatch-gates --tier` over the path gives no path-derived mandate.
Clause-②: no
- An operator log line only (triage `6038494234`): no accept set, answer or public signature moves.
Responsibility: `platform code: @objectstack/cli resolves the runtime assets directory from the cwd and skips the mount without a word (serve.ts:3714–3723, utils/console.ts:615)` | `none: no boot line or check names a branding asset the server cannot serve` | `an operator who boots an artifact outside the app project directory; hotcrm reached it on 17.7.0 (the card body measures it), and every app whose branding names /runtime/assets/* can`
Thread-read: 6038494234
Serial constraints cleared: read 2026-10-07T13:33Z:
- Open PRs (2 read, each file list read by `filename`): neither touches `serve.ts` or `utils/console.ts`. #21988 is the release PR; #21974 holds `domain:spec` and `service-automation` files.
- This seat's same-round siblings: #22079 may add a route in `utils/console.ts`'s console plugin and `serve.ts`'s console mount, and #22073 may touch `serve.ts` where boot diagnostics reach the banner. Those are different regions of paths outside `SINGLE_CLAIM_PATHS` (only `.objectui-sha`), so this is ordinary concurrency and the later lander resolves.

## ACCEPT — PR #22089 at `c397a0f3`, pending CI

<sub>`domain:cli` seat · `session_01RWZbGvPFcRKvUqASZtunCU` · read on GitHub 2026-10-07T15:20Z</sub>

**Checked on GitHub and in the diff, not from the report:**
- **Shape:** draft, base `main`. Line 1 is `Fixes #22071`, line 2 is `Clause-②: no`. Assignee `os-warren`. Labels are the bot's `documentation`, `size/l`, `tests` and `tooling`. There is no `skip-changeset`, which is right: one `patch` changeset ships.
- **Scope:** 5 files, +717 / −26, three commits (fix `a992930d`, pins `0cbf1220`, changeset `c397a0f3`). The files are `serve.ts`, `utils/console.ts`, two test files in `packages/cli/test`, and the changeset. That is inside claim `6039071657`. No `packages/spec`, and nothing in `app-plugin.ts`.
- **`serve.ts`:** the same directory as before (`OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR`, else `<cwd>/assets`). It now also hands `createRuntimeAssetsPlugin` which of the two it came from. The "Silently skips" comment is replaced by what happens now.
- **`utils/console.ts`:**
  - **One resolution.** `resolveRuntimeAssetPath` is the route's old inline resolution, moved verbatim: strip slashes, `path.join`, the traversal guard. The route now serves through it and `runtimeAssetIsServable` judges through it, so the warning and the route cannot disagree (H3).
  - **Matcher.** `runtimeAssetRequest` takes only a root path that resolves on this origin under `/runtime/assets/`. Absolute and protocol-relative URLs, `/\host`, data URIs, relative paths and other root paths are not checked (H4). A subdirectory URL is reported as one.
  - **The check.** It hangs on `kernel:bootstrapped` and reads `protocol.getMetaItems({ type: 'app' })`, the call the REST meta list answers from (H2). It writes one `ctx.logger.warn` per unserved URL, naming the apps and keys, the directory searched, its source, and whether the directory exists. A read failure logs at `debug` and never fails the boot.
  - **The route.** It is still not mounted when the directory is absent, and what it serves is unchanged.
- **Signature:** `createRuntimeAssetsPlugin` gains a required `dirSource`. It is not a published export: `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts:355` pins it as retired from `@objectstack/cli/console`, and its one caller is `serve.ts`. `patch` holds.
- **Sibling #22073 (H5):** the line goes through the kernel logger only. So under the boot-quiet window it is replayed once in *Boot diagnostics*, and the banner list never prints it. #22073's print-once rule has one copy to keep.
- **The seat checked every factual sentence the changeset adds against the branch:**
  - "`objectstack start`, which runs it": `start.ts` spawns the `serve` child. True.
  - "streams live at `--log-level debug` or `info`": `isVerboseBootLevel` (`boot-log-capture.ts:126`) is exactly `debug` / `info`. True.
  - "the same metadata protocol read that `GET /api/v1/meta/app` answers from": the REST meta list calls `getMetaItems` (`rest-server.ts:6078`). True.
  - The matcher and the "nothing under `/runtime/assets/` is mounted" sentences match the code above. True.

**Pins, read in the diff:**
- **`runtime-assets.test.ts` (unit tier, per PR):**
  - the absent directory gives one warning for a file both keys name;
  - the file-present control is silent;
  - a present directory with a missing file warns without claiming the directory is absent;
  - one line per file;
  - the matcher's negative spellings, with a positive control in the same boot;
  - route agreement across query, fragment, dot segments and encoding;
  - the subdirectory case;
  - the never-fails-the-boot case.
- **`serve-runtime-assets-branding-warning.e2e.test.ts`:** three real artifact boots, each in its own `mkdtemp` directory: no `assets/` (warns once, 404), `assets/` beside the artifact (silent, 200) and `OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR` (silent, 200).
- **The dev's ablations through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`:**
  - the hook renamed: unit 9 red, and the e2e no-assets boot red;
  - the decode dropped: the route-agreement case red.
  - Each leg was restored to a blob equal to HEAD.

**The dev's open question (where the boot pin runs): the seat answers A, keep it on the nightly `e2e` tier.**
- The maintainer's 2026-09-07 direction (`packages/cli/vitest.config.ts:596`) moved the `*.e2e.test.*` tier off the per-PR and merge-queue runs.
- The per-PR unit file goes red under both ablations. What only the nightly pin covers is `serve.ts`'s 5-line choice of directory source.

**Evidence (the dev's, at `c397a0f3`):**
- `@objectstack/cli` tests: 352 files, 4692 passed and 2 skipped. Typecheck exits 0.
- `dispatch-gates --ran` accounts for 67 of 67 derived families. `pnpm lint` exits 0.

**The seat's own reading (standing lesson 1, a new `mkdtemp` site):** `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --self-test`, run by the seat in a worktree at `c397a0f3`, printed `✓ dispatch-gates self-test: 1976 cases pass.` and exited 0 (read 2026-10-07T15:07Z).

**Out-of-scope findings:**
- The `sys_migration` UNIQUE-constraint warning on every fresh `:memory:` boot is filed as #22099 (`finding`, for triage).
- `examples/app-todo`'s `/assets/…` branding stays an Acceptance note: it is not measured, and it is outside this check by design.

**CI on `c397a0f3`:** read 2026-10-07T15:19Z: 29 success · 3 skipped (Console Pin Gate, Build Docs, Packed-tarball smoke) · 1 in progress (Test Core 1/6) · 0 red. That is an honest reading, ⛔ not green. GitHub answered HTTP 500 on this commit's check-runs from about 15:08Z to 15:18Z, so the earlier reads could not be taken.

**After green:** the landing pre-checks, then the relay landing.

- **Delivered:** a boot warning when a loaded app's `branding.logo` / `favicon` names a `/runtime/assets/<file>` this boot will not serve. It names the apps and keys, the directory searched, its source (`OS_RUNTIME_ASSETS_DIR` or the `<cwd>/assets` default), and whether the directory exists. What `/runtime/assets/*` serves is unchanged.
- **Not taken, by triage:** carrying the branding files in the artifact. It becomes its own card if a measured cloud or Docker deployment shows the loss.
- **Filed from this card's report:** #22099 (`finding`). Every fresh `:memory:` artifact boot logs `Insert operation failed … UNIQUE constraint failed: sys_migration.id` with a knex stack. It reproduces on `origin/main` before this change. Triage grades it.
